text_simplified: Islam enjoins justice and equality between sons and daughters in love, giving, gifts, education, and treatment, and forbids favoring some children over others; as the Prophet ﷺ said to Bashir ibn Sa'd: "Have you given all of your children the like of this?" He said, "No." He said: "Fear Allah and be just between your children" (Sahih al-Bukhari 2587), and in another narration: "I do not bear witness to injustice" (Sahih Muslim 1623). Favoritism plants resentment among siblings, so parents must nurture love and harmony among them and hasten to enroll their daughters in schools and circles for memorizing the Noble Quran.
